name: healthtrack
description: HealthTrack -- barangay patient information management system (Express + Neon Postgres + React stack).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n PATIENT-API,ADMIN-API,WORKER-API,PATIENT,ADMIN,WORKER "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev:admin --prefix backend" "npm run dev:health-worker --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev:admin --prefix frontend" "npm run dev:health-worker --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
